title: Κυνηγετικά, Cynegetica (On Hunting); «Охота» («Кинегетика»)
author: Pseudo-Oppian (of Apamea)
genre: Didactic hexameter poem on hunting and land animals
edition: Boudreaux 1908; Mair 1928 (US public domain, archive.org); Papathomopoulos 2003 (Teubner).
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia 'Оппиан': only excerpts in Памятники поздней античной поэзии и прозы (1964), pp. 34–39. It does not say which poem.
value: Ancient zoology of land animals, Syrian local lore and Severan court culture. Linked to the famous illustrated manuscript Venice Marc. gr. 479. Pairs with the Halieutica for a didactic 'animal poetry' strand.
ai_feasibility: High. Clear diction. Animal identifications need checking.
